Title: User navigates to Contact Us page and views details
Preconditions: Streamlit app is running (streamlit run ui/app.py) and reachable in browser
Steps: 1. Open the app in a browser | 2. In the left sidebar, click the "Contact Us" radio option | 3. Observe the main panel content
Expected Result: The Contact Us page loads and displays Name: Radhika, Phone: 1234567, and Email: radhika@gmail.com

Title: Contact info displayed in UI matches data served by backend API
Preconditions: Backend is running (uvicorn backend.main:app) and UI is running (streamlit run ui/app.py)
Steps: 1. Start the backend API | 2. Call GET /contact on the backend | 3. Start the UI and navigate to the Contact Us page | 4. Compare the values shown in the UI against the JSON returned by the API
Expected Result: Backend response body {"name":"Radhika","phone":"1234567","email":"radhika@gmail.com"} matches exactly what is rendered on the Contact Us page

Title: Contact Us page renders correctly when accessed as the very first page (deep link / fresh session)
Preconditions: App has never been opened in this browser session (no prior navigation state)
Steps: 1. Open the app URL directly (fresh session, no cached state) | 2. Immediately select "Contact Us" from the sidebar before interacting with "Home" | 3. Observe rendered content
Expected Result: Contact Us page renders fully and correctly on first interaction with no missing fields or stale/blank state

Title: Switching between Home and Contact Us pages preserves correct content on each
Steps: 1. Select ""Home"" in the sidebar and confirm home content is shown | 2. Select ""Contact Us"" in the sidebar and confirm contact content is shown | 3. Switch back to ""Home"" and confirm it still renders correctly
Expected Result: Each page shows the correct, unmixed content every time the user switches between them via the sidebar radio

Title: Backend /contact endpoint rejects unsupported HTTP methods
Steps: 1. Send a POST request to /contact | 2. Send a DELETE request to /contact | 3. Observe the HTTP status codes returned
Expected Result: Backend returns HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed for both requests since /contact only supports GET
